rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Very steep residential street, about 19% grade, with homes 8-12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses line the kerb; dwellings 8-11 m away along the first 35 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few parked cars; narrow ground beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a busy road.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street but no overnight convention seen.

sun_shade: Mostly shaded by street trees on the north side, open to the south.

best_section.where: Highview Terrace just up from the main road junction, north side
